question: In a certain code language, 'ARGUE’ is written as '22620926' and 'BEACH' is written as '1924262225'. How will 'ACCEL' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

Logic : Position value of immediate opposite letters according to English alphabetic series are written in reverse order.

So,

 
• 'ARGUE’ is written as '22620926'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0800afd93951ed03fac50373b711c0ab43a731b7074402490652e379b1aead04.png] 

 
• 'BEACH' is written as '1924262225'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11c6d638c32a4378548b02e13fc2b73bfffcbb2ed62f6c01b9d1edd6a5aa9a48.png] 

Similarly, 

 
• 'ACCEL' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eefd346e2584bf108a2152f42a763ec48f6a03763a220ff040ceceb1a0426df4.png] 

Hence, "**1522242426**" is the correct answer.
